learning_objective: 🎯 We will enjoy a wonderful story about a special character and learn the true meaning of friendship and care!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Having a wonderful friend like Hekko brings lots of joy and laughter to our lives. Spending time with those we love is always magical.
We must always be kind to our friends and take good care of them. True love and kindness make the world a much better place.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Draw Your Best Friend
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a beautiful picture of your best friend or your favorite animal and give it to them with a very big smile!

quick_recap: ⭐ Friendship is one of the most beautiful gifts we can have.
⭐ We should always be kind and gentle to animals and people.
⭐ Taking care of others makes our own hearts happy.
